title: Metric Design Fundamentals
description: Turn a product goal into a defensible measurement system: choose the primary success metric, separate it from guardrails and vanity metrics, pin down a definition that means what you claim, and speak the metric vocabulary a business model runs on.
outcomes: You'll choose a defensible success metric for a launch, tell it apart from a guardrail or a vanity metric, catch a definition that lets a metric drift from what it claims to measure, and recognize the metric a given business model actually runs on.
